prompt.en: Generate a Gantt chart and a timeline for the project based on @Project Implementation Plan.docx
prompt.zh: 根据 @Project Implementation Plan.docx 帮我生成一张项目甘特图和一张时间线图。

reply.en: Generated both views from the implementation plan: a Gantt chart breaking down all 20 tasks across the 6 phases with role assignments and dependencies, and a milestone timeline marking each phase gate along the ~26.5-week schedule.
reply.zh: 已根据实施计划生成两张图：一张甘特图，按 6 个阶段拆解全部 20 个任务并标出负责角色与依赖关系；一张时间线图，标出约 26.5 周排期中每个阶段的关键里程碑（Gate）。
